newsitem.title: UK: Iceland shares jump on buyback news.
newsitem.headline: Iceland shares jump on buyback news.

text.p: Shares in Iceland Group Plc jumped on Wednesday after the frozen food chain said it would cancel 35 percent of its ordinary shares at 105p per share, and 37.5 percent of its convertible preference shares at 96p per share.
Iceland ordinary shares were 10p higher at 97-1/2 by 0835 GMT.
"They are cancelling a lot of their shares at a good premium to the market and that's pushed the price up," one market maker said.
Iceland also announced a sharp drop in 1996 profits, blaming unsatisfactory like-for-like sales.
It added that like-for-like sales in the year to date were up 0.5 percent compared with the same period last year.
